beaches.name: Dytiko (Diskos), Lentas
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix along the beach, with nudity concentrated at the eastern end. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2021; a 2017 Cretan news article calls it an established beach for nudists and a 2021 directory entry lists it as a nude beach. Older reports mention a painted request not to bathe nude in front of the buildings; no report is newer than 2021 and no designation is documented.

beaches.name: Trafoulas (Trachoulas), east of Lentas
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the cove at the mouth of the Trafoulas gorge. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2021; the 2021 report found a roughly 60/40 mix of clothed and nude, the 2020 report mainly nudists, and a German directory entry dated 17 September 2020 reports about 20 couples, all nude. No designation or signage is documented and no report is newer than 2021.
